correctness.rationale: For q>=2,r>=1, W_{j+1}=W_j0^(rq^j)W_j, each W_j starts/ends with 1 and has longest internal zero-run rq^(j-1). The explicit B_j=0^(rq^j)W_j consequently precedes every proper suffix and is Lyndon; strictly increasing leading zero runs make the factor list strictly descending. CFL uniqueness gives exact finite factors, nesting gives infinite factors, and the explicit recurrence yields the rational generating function. The q=2 double-root limit is derived separately. Finite independent Duval checks corroborate, but do not replace, the proof.

value.rationale: An entire natural two-parameter family of sparse morphic words has a complete explicit CFL factor classification, not a pointwise reparameterization or arbitrary finite slice. The canonical boundary sequence has a closed rational generating function and an intrinsic scale transition: q=2 has j*2^j boundaries whereas q>2 has q^j boundaries. It also gives the classical Cantor special case n_j=q^j; the result may facilitate factorized algorithms and questions about morphic word structure, although such applications are not asserted as theorems.
